identityBoundary.rule: Daily vocabulary and scene vocabulary are fully independent content spaces. They use distinct identity namespaces, separate progress, scores and mastery evidence. The same text is permitted in both spaces but never creates a shared reference.
identityBoundary.wrongAnswerHandling: The unified wrong-answer library may retain a source label for traceability only; it does not merge content identities or mastery.
identityBoundary.lexicalNormalization: lowercase en-US; punctuation and whitespace collapsed
identityBoundary.phraseRule: A normalized English value containing a space is a phrase; otherwise it is a word.
identityBoundary.homographRule: Same normalized English form with different Chinese senses is split within its own namespace. Across namespaces, matching text or sense remains independent.
identityBoundary.migrationRule: Existing daily term+meaningZh and scene targetText+correctMeaningZh are mapped independently. Lexical overlap is reported only as a content-planning statistic.

capacityTargets.planningRule: Daily and scene targets are independently counted. Textual overlap does not reduce either target or create a shared identity.

r17Scope.rule: Only daily vocabulary capacity is calculated by this audit. Listening and speaking remain in R17 scope but are not expanded by this vocabulary capacity batch.

levelCapacity.allocation: Equal planning target of 200 daily knowledge points per user-facing level; actual production batches may rebalance only with a new mapping version.
